size_rules.mid: Rust LOC >= 2000 and < 50000 and workspace crates <= 20

design_notes: Two axes (size x edit) yield 12 cells. Disk usage is a recorded metric, not a third axis: a disk tertile would triple the grid and leave most cells empty while four agents are still seeding.

Fitness is median wall time in milliseconds of the configured iteration loop (genome.loop: check, graph, test, or build) on that edit type. Lower is better. Spread is population stdev of the timed samples. loop=build is the cranelift-dev gene; cargo check skips codegen so cranelift cannot occupy a check-loop cell on merit.

validate is not a gene. It is always cargo test with default LLVM rustc. A genome that fails the correctness gate (fast path and rustc must agree on broken edits; validate is the final signal) cannot occupy a cell.
Replace an elite only when the new median is at least fitness.min_gain_pct faster (default 3%) and correctness.ok is true. Seed an empty cell with the first passing evaluation.
Stop a cell after fitness.max_non_improving consecutive non-improving tries. Hill-climb restarts may re-seed a stopped cell with a new genome family.
Do not stack RUSTC_WRAPPER=nanocompile with sccache. Cranelift is a dev-backend gene only; rust-loop run strips it from validate.
Other agents write bench/archive/<sample>.json shards. Merge with `nanocompile map-elites merge` or `python3 tools/map_elites.py merge`.
Size is by Rust LOC: small < 2000, mid 2000..50000 and <=20 crates. rust-loop-medium (202 LOC) is small; do not let it occupy mid.
fitness_method is recorded per elite. official_first_rebuild (this harness) and restore_rebuild_mean_of_medians (PR #11) are not comparable as raw ms.
cache_state=warm_compiler_cache means sccache/nanocompile survived an emptied target/. It is not true empty-cache cold and does not set the iteration default.
package_scope=touched (cargo check -p hub) fails the sig_dep correctness gate unless dependents_agree_on_broken. Fallback elite is workspace check.
Promote weights real samples (midsize, pinned-*) over rust-loop fixtures. Fixture cells stay sample-specific when real elites exist.
